text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
First across the line is Air Messiah, it's 
Air Messiah! Air Messiah has conquered the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup! A graceful Queen 
of Autumn is born right here, right now!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Did I manage... to show them?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Just as Mother once did for me... I, too, 
shall reach deep into your heart—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(My yearning. My strength. Was I able to 
engrave my "steps"...?)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Messiah-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing! It was so incredible!! 
I... I wanna... uuuuughhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Messiah-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No, her vocabulary... Shouldn't you start 
by learning a thing or two from her first?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Leave them be. Sincere feelings will 
always reach their mark. ...See? They're 
smiling, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're right, she's smiling. Ah, she 
really does look so happy...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, oh my, what should I do! It seems 
to have rubbed off on me too. Fufu, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy, so very happy... Hehehe, I 
just want to shout it out to everyone here 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That she's my beloved daughter, I'd say! 
That she's my absolute pride and joy!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
She's sure to grow into an even more 
wonderful girl... and walk toward a 
brilliantly bright future—!

And a few days after the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup.

We decided to hold a modest victory 
celebration in the trainer's office.

Of course, we must prepare thoroughly 
beforehand. We will decide on the event 
with the theme of 'Celebrating victory and 
gathering strength for the next step,' 
and—

"Next, I sent out invitations with the 
date, time, and location clearly stated to 
Air Messiah's friends, upperclassmen, and 
underclassmen."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
They said they would come over after 
school, everyone.
choice_data_list:
Shall we get started ahead of time, just 
as planned?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. First off was the "celebratory party 
poppers", right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
By the way, this might sound like a 
strange question, but... Trainer, are you 
used to party poppers?
choice_data_list: I-I might not be... used to it.

text_block_list.text:
I honestly confess that I hadn't lived the 
kind of life where party poppers made 
frequent appearances in the first place, 
so it's been a long time since I last held 
one.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... No, I am at a similar skill 
level myself.
choice_data_list:
(What does party popper proficiency even 
mean...?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
When I was invited to the gathering with 
Heart-san's friends before, I must have 
pulled the cord too hard, as it failed to 
make a sound...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, that wouldn't serve as much of a 
"celebratory boost."
choice_data_list:
True, we wouldn't want to get our momentum 
killed right at the start...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just as you say. In that case, the first 
step is...

After pondering for a moment, I take out 
my smartphone. Double-checking the product 
name, I type it into the search bar—
choice_data_list: Ah... There it is! The manual!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: My!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer. Let us begin 
by thoroughly going through that first.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...The biggest rule, after all, is that 
'you must not ring it at people or 
Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The reason is evident from notices such 
as ‘Loud noises will sound’ and ‘Large 
amounts of tape will burst out.’"
choice_data_list:
For safety's sake, I want to make sure we 
get that part right.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...If that is the case, then to be 
precise—

Together with Air Messiah, I face the 
wall, taking two... no, three solid steps 
back to keep our distance.

And after exchanging glances and nodding, 
we pulled our party poppers on the count 
of three.
(Pat!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright. That was a proper and 
thorough 'pep rally,' wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To you as well, Trainer. 
...Congratulations.
